__note: Canned response for GET /api/v4/entity/AuditInspection/list?CreatedAfter=<now-24h> (Create WO source module 24). Built node 'EHS: List Inspections' reads $json.List; 'Prepare Inspections' emits one item per element and 'EHS: Fetch Inspection Detail' fetches by RowUID. Only RowUID is consumed from these summary rows; BusinessEntity/FormNumber are included for readability. The full inspection bodies live in ehs-inspection-fetch.json keyed by RowUID. All 11 rows are treated as created in the last 24h (the mock ignores the CreatedAfter query filter).
__order_note: ROW ORDER IS PART OF THE TEST (OQ-037, cases I and J, added 2026-07-26). EHS-INSP-J must stay immediately BEFORE EHS-INSP-E: J is a draft whose UpdatedDtm is later than E's, so a 'drop drafts after picking the max' implementation would keep J and cut a WO from a draft, while the correct pre-dedupe guard drops J and lets E survive. Reordering these two silently weakens case J to nothing.
